name: ATask kernel
role: Goal/task/proof/human boundary; externally validated claims; run accounting.
boundary: No planning intelligence. Owns factual execution state and bounded H-task interface.

name: Seed0
role: Project-shape standard, tournament harness, multi-seed experiments and learning candidates.
boundary: Learns from runs and compares implementations; does not redefine truth or authority.

name: QP / A-COM
role: Deterministic gates, grants, receipts, proof levels, authority for consequential actions.
boundary: Cognition is untrusted; canonical state and external effects require gates/grants.

name: Cmail
role: Reusable company identity acquisition: domain, email, phone, handles and onboarding adapters.
boundary: Credentials are references; consequential calls flow through QP capability grants.

name: Security gate
role: Secret scanning, untrusted-repo preflight, egress/action policy, prompt-injection regressions.
boundary: Security checks are deterministic gates, not LLM assurances.

name: Demand sensing
role: Reusable source→normalized record→typed signal pipeline for Pinterest/Etsy/TikTok/Shopify/marketplace signals.
boundary: Signals are evidence; they do not directly authorize spend or publishing.

name: ChatGPT capability surface
role: Compile capabilities into ChatGPT-native/MCP/app surfaces plus web/API/x402 variants.
boundary: Surface is downstream of a tested capability contract.

name: UNDERENGINEER
role: High-level project manager: pick the earliest real moat event and build only the prerequisites, safety and verification needed to reach it.
boundary: Never optimizes for smallest codebase. Optimizes for shortest credible path to controlled scarce-state accretion and then pauses for evidence.

name: WORLD_SELECT
role: Select the cheapest real experiment world capable of changing the decision.
boundary: Simulation can rank worlds; only external evidence resolves real-world claims.

name: PORTFOLIO Scheduler
role: Allocate scarce experiment resources across fast truth, fast demand, economic and deep scarce-state lanes.
boundary: Cannot invent capacity or bypass account/human/QP constraints.

name: Strategic H-Task Desk
role: Surface only bounded strategic, physical, KYC/spend and trust/relationship questions that machines cannot validly close.
boundary: Implementation/debugging questions must stay with agents when a machine test exists.

name: BreadUp Self-Lab
role: Use our own opportunity→probe→outcome dataset loop before selling the intelligence to BreadUp users.
